translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Geeshsha Golliyaa Kees's'anaw Haneedda Giiguwaa
Hewaa diraw, Daawite, «Med'inaa Godaa S'oossaa Geeshsha Golliyaa hawaan de'anawaa; Israa'eeliyaa Asay s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa yarshshana sa'ay hawaa gidanawaa» yaageedda.
Geeshsha Golliyaa Kees's'anaw Giigissiyaa Giiguwaa

Hewaa diraw, Daawite Israa'eeliyaa biittan de'iyaa hara biittaa asatuwaa shiishshanaadan azazeedda. S'oossaa Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'anaw shuchchaa massiyaawanttu shuchchaa massiide loytsanaw unttunttu giddoppe suntseedda.
Daawite penggiyaa sank'k'aa ootsanaw misimaariyawunne maas'afiyaw haniyaa c'ora birataanne mazzananaw danddayettenna, zawi baynna nahaasiyaa birataa giigisseedda.
Sidoona asatuunne S'iiroosa asatuu Daawitaw zigaa ahiyaa diraw, Daawite paydu baynna zigaa giigisseedda.

Daawite, «Ta na'ay Solomone oosuwaa meezetibeennanne yalaga na'aa. Med'inaa Godaw kees'ettiyaa Geeshsha Golliyaa biittaa ubbaan eretteeddanne bonchchetteedda, lo"o golliyaa gidanaw besse. Hewaa diraw, aw koshshiyaawaa taani giigissana» yaageedda. Daawite hayk'k'anaappe kasetiide darobaa giigissi wotseedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Daawite bare na'aa Solomona s'eesiide, Med'inaa Godaw Israa'eeliyaa S'oossaw Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'anaadan azazeedda.
Daawite Solomona, «Ta na'aw, taani Med'inaa Godaa ta S'oossaa suntsaw Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'anaw ta wozanaan k'oppaad.

Shin Med'inaa Godaa k'aalay taana, ‹Neeni daro suutsaa gussaadda; k'ay daro olaakka olettaadda. Neeni ha sa'aa bollan ta sintsan daro suutsaa gusseedda diraw, ta suntsaw Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'akka.

Be'a; new itti saro na'i yelettanawaa. Aa yuushshuwaan de'iyaa morkkatuwaa ubbaanna taani Aa saro ootsana. Aa suntsay Solomona; taani I kaateteedda laytsan Israa'eeliyaa asaw sarotetsaanne woppaa immana.
I ta suntsaw Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'ana. I ta na'aa gidanawaa; taanikka aw aawuwaa gidana. Aa kawutetsaa araataa Israa'eelan med'inaw minissa essana› yaageedda.
«Ha"ikka ta na'aw, Med'inaa Goday neenana gido. S'oossay kase nebaa haasayeeddawaadan, Med'inaa Godaa ne S'oossay Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'anawaa neena polisso.
Med'inaa Goday neena Israa'eeliyaa asaa bolla kaatiyaa ootsiyaa wode, Med'inaa Godaa ne S'oossaa higgiyaa naaganaadan, S'oossay new aad'd'eeda eratetsaanne akeekaa immo.
Med'inaa Goday Muse baggana Israa'eeliyaa azazeedda azazuwaanne wogaa naagiyaawaa gidooppe, ubbay new hanana. Aynne baawaa minna! Yayyoppa woy dagammoppa!

Taani daro tuggaan Med'inaa Godaa Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'anaw heezzu sha"anne oyddu s'eetu kiilo giraame dees'iyaa work'k'aanne hattamanne oyddu sha"a kiilo giraame dees'iyaa biraa shiishshay; k'ay zaway baynna nahaasiyaanne birataa shiishshay; k'aykka mitsaanne shuchchaa giigissaad. Gidoppekka, neeni hewaa bolla haraa gujjanaw koshshee.
Ne matan daro oosanchchatuu de'iino; shuchchaa k'oo'iyaawanttunne massiyaawanttu, anaas'etuunne ubbaa kiitaa ootsanaw danddayiyaa eranchcha asatuu de'iino.
Unttunttu ootsiyaa work'k'aw, biraw, nahaasiyawunne birataw zaway baawa. Ha"i neeni kiitaa doomma. Med'inaa Goday neenana gido» yaageedda.
Daawite Israa'eeliyaa kaaletsiyaawanttu ubbay bare na'aa Solomona maaddanaadan hawaadan yaagiide azazeedda;

«Med'inaa Goday hinttenttu S'oossay hinttenana de'enneeyye? I hinttentta ubba saanna shemppissibeennee? Ha biittan de'iyaawantta I ta kushiyan aatsi immeedda diraw, ha biittay Med'inaa Godawunne Aa asaw moodetteedda.

Ha"ikka Med'inaa Godaa hinttenttu S'oossaa koyanaw hinttenttu wozanaanne hinttenttu shemppuwaa immite. Med'inaa Godaa suntsaw kees'etteedda Geeshsha Golliyaa giddon Med'inaa Godaa K'aalaa c'aak'uwa Taabootaanne S'oossaa geeshsha miishshatuwaa ahiidde wotsanaadan, hinttenttu denddiide, Med'inaa Godaa S'oossaa Geeshsha Golliyaa kees's'ite» yaageedda.
